title: Capt Evan Denis Charters
specs: USCG Licensed captain with first aid training
Experienced in fishing snook, redfish, and tarpon
No age minimum stated; trips can be tailored for children
Tarpon are the ultimate gamefish with their huge size up to over 200lbs, high jumps, and long runs.
To target these tarpon we will be using mostly live bait and artificial baits on 8' rods with 6,000 to 10,000 sized Shimano Saragosas with 30 - 50lb braid.

With these rod and reel combos we will be able to land the fish in a quick amount of time to make sure that the Tarpon swim away strong and you don't get too worn out, so you can fight another silver king. #We look forward to you joining us!
Up to 4 guests per boat; additional fees for 4th angler

services.name: 4 Hour Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Join us for a 4 hour charter! 4 Hours About The Clearwater/St. Pete area has one of the most diverse fisheries the state of Florida has to offer. Year-round there is always something to target. Most inshore trips will be targeting snook, trout, and redfish but you are more than likely going to catch many other species while targeting them. Using light tackle spinning gear to target trophy gamefish is test for even the most avid anglers. Capt. Evan also specializes in teaching the newest anglers how to get the most out of their time on the Up to 4 people • All ages

blurb: Come join Captain Evan Denis along the beautiful waters off the Gulf Coast of Florida with year round fishing for your next trophy catch. Capt. Evan is a native Floridian with over 2 decades fishing these local waters. The Captain is USCG Licensed and insured. Evan has spent many years on these local waters learning where the fish are and the patterns that they follow.
